status: Outcome-access boundary for this acquisition only; not a preregistered final cohort, trained model or external evaluation.
reserved_final_candidates: All 105 phase7 candidate structures plus their canonical parents and conservative >=0.70 Morgan radius2 2048-bit chiral similarity neighborhood. No development outcomes may be extracted for any matched material.

observed_exposure.event: An OECD TG492 search snippet displayed an in-vivo Category 1 and assay outcome while locating public sources. This chemical is permanently excluded from prospective blind final evaluation in both tracks and conservatively flagged as eye risk pending test-article/source adjudication.

separation: Only exact-CAS/structure matched chemicals demonstrably outside the full reserved set can be copied as development results. Unmapped/ambiguous chemicals and source records must be quarantined before result parsing/export. Any previously seen or downloaded public result is retrospective development, never prospective-blind final data.
skin: Preserve each original assay/version and condition. EpiDerm 2004 15min/42h is distinct from current EpiDerm SIT 60min/42h. Do not declare historical method TG439 compliance without a method-specific basis.
eye: OECD TG492 EpiOcular native No Category or No prediction can be made is an assay-specific endpoint; no prediction is NOT an irritant label. Keep TG492, TG491, TG467, Draize, GHS and EPA separate.
gating_order: skin corrosion and eye GHS Category 1 risk evidence
label_custody: No independent custodian exists. Public results are development only; final evaluation remains blocked.
primary_risk_gate: phase14_public_data/src/risk_gates.py: v2 with additional strict type checking for all joint-gate inputs. The phase13 gate remains archived and is no longer the active gate.
pilot: Metadata coverage, independent source/run counts and class distribution; exploratory only, confidence intervals disclosed. Confirmatory sample size and paired power must be finalized prospectively, not selected based on pilot performance.
